notes: Corrected: the opening *The* is moved from a supplied determiner on the construct `שַׂר` to the present article on the attributive `הַשְּׁלִישִׁי`. Rule 47 holds even where the head noun is a construct that could take no article of its own, and a present article morpheme takes the English *the* before a supplied one does; the phrase's two *the*s then answer to its two article morphemes, each standing before its own word.
This is the same count v.8 runs for `הַחֲמִישִׁי ... הַשַּׂר`, where the single *the* stands before *fifth* and the first article takes it.
The ASV marginal note (*Or, chief minister*) was read and set aside; the printed text is aligned (rule 38).
